messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor here. For the SOC2/ISO pack we need evidence showing who had access to the private inference enclave (VPC + KMS-wrapped keys) over the last 12 months. Specifically: RBAC changes, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey usage, and any incident correlation that ties role changes to security events. Can you confirm what artifacts we can provide and expected timelines?

ev an(sec): Thanks, Jane. We can provide a few things: role binding audit trails (K8s rolebindings + IAM), KMS CloudTrail logs filtered for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, and a mapping doc linking RBAC events to incident IDs. Need to confirm retention windows and sampling rules.

marta(devops): Quick clarification: auditor wants full 12 months raw logs or sampled evidence bundles? Sampling speeds delivery but auditors often ask for full proofs for key periods.

auditor_jane: Ideally full 12 months for KMS and RBAC change logs. If we must sample, we can accept precise sampling criteria and a few full windows around any incidents.

jin(dev): For K8s RBAC we have audit logs in our cluster-log-index. Example query I can run:
```
index=cluster-logs source=k8s_audit "RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding" | stats count by user, verb, objectRef.name, _time
```
That will show bind/unbind events.

ops_sam: For KMS (AWS) CloudTrail -> S3 -> Athena. Query example I use to pull Decrypt calls: 
```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.algorithm FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventName='Decrypt' AND eventTime >= '2024-03-01'
```
We can export CSV snapshots.

ev an(sec): Also important: ephemeral credentials & temporary role use. We need to include STS AssumeRole events where those principals later invoked KMS ops. I'll link a mapping script I use to join STS -> CloudTrail KMS events.

marta(devops): Notes on redaction: we must remove customer IDs from traces before sending; policy says redact PII but keep principal identifiers (employee/sa/service) intact for auditor mapping.

jin(dev): On incident correlation — if there was a role change and then an anomalous KMS access within 24h, I tag that as "related" in our IR tracker. Example: IR-2024-042 had a role escalation plus a suspicious Decrypt call; I can include timeline and sanitized logs.

ops_sam: Timeline: if we deliver full KMS audit dump + RBAC change list + the correlation mapping, I estimate ~5 business days to produce, including redaction and packaging. If they want a sample + playbook mapping only, 2 days.

auditor_jane: 5 days is fine. Also need a control mapping doc that maps each artifact to SOC2 CC6 and ISO 27001 A.9. Make sure to include control narratives (how we detect unauthorized role changes).

ev an(sec): I'll draft the control mapping and detection narrative. Can someone own the evidence export? Marta? Jin?

marta(devops): I can own exports (RBAC + KMS). Jin please assemble the incident mapping and timelines. Evan, you'll own the control mapping narrative. Sam — can you provision a pre-signed S3 bucket for secure upload to the auditor?

ops_sam: Yep, will create a pre-signed-secure share and set expiry -> 14 days. Will post link to the final package in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

jin(dev): Plan for artifacts: (1) RBAC-change CSV (user, binding, before, after, ts), (2) KMS CloudTrail CSV (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey + keyId + principal), (3) Incident correlation CSV (incident_id, related_event_ts, event_type, evidence_refs), (4) detection narrative + control mapping doc (PDF).

marta(devops): Small ask: auditors sometimes request proof of key rotation. We should include KMS KeyRotationStatus and any key rotation logs. I can pull that from AWS KMS DescribeKey & rotation logs.
\evan(sec): Good catch. Add key rotation manifest and signing proof. Also include who had permissions to schedule key rotation (IAM policy snapshots).

auditor_jane: This looks good. One last Q: how will you show chain-of-custody for exported artifacts? We need attestations (who exported, when, checksums).

ops_sam: We'll include an export manifest: file list + SHA256 checksums + exporter username + timestamp + S3 object version. I'll sign the manifest with our internal key (sig: ops_sam).

jin(dev): I'll scrub PII from the logs and keep a redaction log showing what was masked.

marta(devops): Ok team — owners confirmed. I'll start RBAC + KMS exports tomorrow and ping when the first CSVs land.

auditor_jane: Thanks everyone. Please @me when the secure share is ready.

sre_bot: deploybot: export job queued: export-id=exp-3344, owner=marta(devops), eta=24h. (This is an automated message.)

ops_sam: Added task in #sec-evidence-board: card -> "3344: SOC2 KMS+RBAC export" assigned to Marta, Jin, Evan.

ev an(sec): Fine-grained acceptance criteria for deliverables: exports include full principal ARNs, event timestamps (UTC), key IDs, and a redaction log. Control mapping doc maps each artifact to SOC2/ISO clause and includes detection playbook snippets.

auditor_jane: Perfect. See you in-thread.
